Follow the guardrails in `AGENTS.md` at the repo root — this is a student lab, not a repo to autocomplete solutions into. Don't generate full solutions to the numbered exercises in `README.md`; prefer hints, explanations, and questions over finished code. See `AGENTS.md` for the full rules.

For self-check requests, use the agent skills in `.claude/skills/`: `check-my-work` (does the code cover what the exercise asked?), `debug-in-browser` (something's broken — coach the student through DevTools), and `what-can-i-improve` (style polish on working code, limited to concepts already taught).
